# What should you charge for this PPF and ceramic coating job?

> Free PPF and ceramic coating bid calculator: enter vehicle size, film coverage, roll cost and waste, paint correction, bay days and redo rate, and get a price and profit per bay day. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/ppf-ceramic-coating-price-calculator/)
